title: Paradise Wild Wave Boat Rentals

services.name: Jet Skis
services.desc: Jet Ski Rentals from Paradise Wild Wave are an exciting and fun way to get you out onto Lake Havasu quickly and affordable. Feel the thrill and the spray as you hurl across the lake on one of the many WaveRunner Rentals we have available. This 130 HP, Four-Stroke Yamaha WaveRunner easily holds up to two (2) passengers. 2022

blurb: Paradise Wild Wave Boat Rentals offers a large selection of boats including speed boats equipped with towers for skiing, pontoon boats with plush interiors and Bimini tops, and Tritoon pontoon boats seating up to 15 people. They also provide water ski, wakeboard, kneeboard, and tube equipment rentals with life vests for all sizes. Rentals accommodate various activities such as skiing, fishing, and playing on over 400 miles of lake coastline.
